moves.name: Pyro Ball
moves.description: Removes the frozen condition from the user. Has a chance (10%) of leaving the target burned.

moves.name: Bounce
moves.description: The user begins bouncing. After a set time, the user stops bouncing and attacks. Has a chance (30%) of leaving the target paralyzed. No other actions can be taken while bouncing. Most moves used by opponents will not hit the user while it is bouncing. If the user is attacked by a sync move or max move while bouncing, it will stop bouncing.

moves.name: High Jump Kick
moves.description: When it fails, the user takes damage equal to 50% of its maximum HP.

moves.name: Kickoff!
moves.description: Raises the user’s Attack by 4 stat ranks. Raises the user’s evasiveness by 1 stat rank. Raises the user’s critical-hit rate by 3 stat ranks.
